reviews.review: Just finished the game in single player while consuming four glasses of whiskey. Pawned final boss the first time I've met him. Alcohol can unlock the werewolf in me. - h e l l o f a g a m e -

Risk of Rain is a quirky and fun 2D action roguelike, which is a lot more fun when played with other people.

The minitaure-sized sprites all look great and have their charm, and the timer-based difficulty setting was a really interesting touch that forces you to balance going around the maps to collect much-needed upgrades with not wasting too much time in any given area to avoid raising the difficulty too much. The different character specializations are fun to experiment with, even more so when playing co-op, since you can mix and match them to cover each other's weak points.

As negative aspects, I'd say that the lack of enemy and level variety coupled with cryptic conditions for unlocking new playable characters make this a game that is best played in short bursts. Enemy variety is limited to a few level-specific ones, and the challenge comes more from the game spawning lots of them and giving them ever-increasing stats than actually learning their attack patterns and how to overcome them; then, the levels themselves seem to have a few basic layouts that are repeated often, making them quite predictable after just a few runs. I only wish you'd start with more characters or the conditions for unlocking them were simpler, since having to play with the same ones over and over wasn't as fun, especially in co-op mode.

In spite of its shortcomings, I'd definitely recommend Risk of Rain to anyone who likes co-op action games, as the short-ish average play sessions means you can have fun and experience some crazy and fun situations without a huge time commitment, and playing in short bursts means you won't get burned out by the relatively shallow enemy and level variety and will be able to enjoy it a lot more.
a solid 2d, COOP fun with good difficulty and addicting gameplay
Still an amazing game, some multiplayer issues though outstanding all for all.
